facts.text: Serve the main when the boys reach Agamemnon's feast.
facts.why: Agamemnon adopts Kevin and orders 'Let the banquet begin', and the dwarfs turn up at that banquet posing as magic act helpers before stealing his riches.

facts.text: Robin Hood's men keep the takings.
facts.why: Robin Hood takes the dwarfs' haul and gives it to the poor, and the dwarfs leave angry. Randall complains about him 'giving away what isn't even his'.
facts.fix: Robin Hood hands the takings to the poor.

vibe.verdict: A neat map-room tavern with the right historical stops, held back by a boxed poster and generic pub food.
missing: Evil's speech about digital watches and the microchip
The cage over the bottomless pit
The dwarfs' soft-shoe 'Me and My Shadow' for Napoleon
Kevin's parents and the smouldering rock in the toaster oven
The Supreme Being: 'I am the nice one'
ideas: Swap 'Ploughman's board' for a rat-on-toast joke starter named 'Vermin's rat, anybody?'
Replace the mackerel pâté note with 'Robin Hood hands the takings to the poor'
Rename 'Napoleon's little custard tarts' to 'Napoleon's dinner tarts' and add a note that the dwarfs rob him after he passes out from wine
Crop the poster so it fills the frame instead of sitting between black bars
changed: Evil's digital watches wink in place of the map wink
